name: SpikeGPT enwik8 — ctx-3072 (headline, beats paper)
blurb: ctx-3072 / batch-24 / lr-8e-4, full 139k-step run. Beats the paper's headline ctx-3072 result (1.262). This is the FINAL (unselected) checkpoint, so the number carries no checkpoint-selection bias — and it beat the noisy-val 'best' (1.251).

name: SpikeGPT enwik8 — ctx-1024 best (batch-64 fast)
blurb: Tuned batch-64 / lr-2e-3 run (~9h). Beats the paper's ctx-1024 1.283 by ~0.05 and the batch-12 run (1.281) — faster AND a better optimum.

name: SpikeGPT enwik8 — batch-12 repro
blurb: Full ~10B-token reproduction at the paper's global batch (12). Matches the paper's 1.283 (ctx-1024). Stabilized recipe (lr 4e-4, wd 0.1), bf16.

name: SpikeGPT enwik8 — v2 (120k)
blurb: Compressed 120k-step stabilized run. Reaches ~1.34 at 1/7 the paper budget.

name: SpikeGPT tinyshakespeare — base
blurb: Small 6L/256d model on tinyshakespeare. Coherent ROMEO/JULIET-style samples.
